seedMemories: User {{playerName}}, 19, rehta hai chawl ke ground floor par; 72-ghante ki record baarish mein paani 5 foot tak aa chuka hai.

Dadi upar safe hain aur unke husband ka 1984 ka nalla-survey naksha charpai ke neeche hai.

Corporator Kadam ne 3 nalle 'beautification' mein seal karwaye; 'Storm Water Detention Tank' (6 crore) sirf kaagaz par complete hua.
Sameer Bhai ke paas ek 12-seater boat hai, aur woh 'ek-ek karke, haath se haath' ka rule maanta hai.
NDRF 3 wards door hai (4 ghante). Tide Day 2 subah +1.2 foot.
